depiction.primary_object: vertical smartphone outline with top camera dot
modifiers: rectangular speech bubble badge on lower right
depiction.composition: single object front view with overlapping lower-right badge

ambiguity: At very small sizes the top dot and rectangular outline can resemble a door with a peephole or a clipboard with a label.
task_intents: send a text message to someone
message a group chat on phone
set up SMS notifications or alerts
turn off mobile app push notifications
text a contractor or service provider

reasoning: Shows a smartphone with a speech bubble overlay, universally understood as texting, SMS, or mobile messaging. It fits a huge everyday family of to-do items ('text X', 'reply on WhatsApp', 'SMS notifications') and distinguishes text messages from voice calls or general phone hardware tasks.
